text: At dawn on the eleventh day, the main gate collapsed.
Thousands poured into the breached courtyard, shouting victory.
But Mansa Dianke Wali had already gathered the remaining royal council inside the subterranean gunpowder vaults.
He looked at his commanders, nodded in solemn brotherhood, and touched a flaming torch to the iron magazines.
A deafening roar shook the earth for forty miles across the savannas.
When the smoke cleared, the fortress of Kansala had vanished into legend, leaving nothing for the conquerors to chain.
